summary: Describes an email authentication method, compatible with RFC 8601, that looks up the sender's IP address in a DNS whitelist. It exists to document the method in case it is seen in practice, suggest a useful practice, and register the relevant keywords. It does not consider blacklists. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some mail servers keep a public list of trusted senders and check it before accepting mail. This document describes how a mail system records the result of that check in message headers.

questions: how are dns whitelist results recorded in email headers
